risk_summary: The excerpt is generally precise and well quantified, with detailed year-over-year revenue, margin, expense, and acquisition impacts. Risk tone is moderately negative due to recession-driven demand declines, reduced capital spending, acquisition-related costs, and facility-consolidation charges, although operating profitability remained substantial. Repeated acquisition adjustments and extensive legal risk disclaimers add some boilerplate and reduce clarity without materially obscuring the financial trends.
